title: glochidion poilanei
intro: Glochidion poilanei, commonly known as the Poilane's Glochidion, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It is a shrub or small tree that has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Glochidion poilanei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
